changes_vs_old: Placeholders replaced: north Bengal = Darjeeling, Kalimpong, Jalpaiguri, Alipurduar, Cooch Behar (Cooch Behar added for contiguity with western Assam); the 6 transferred Assam districts validated; Malda and the Dinajpurs moved to seat 39.

Entire Bhutan + Himalayan neighbours (Sikkim/Darjeeling Buddhist/Nepali-Bhutia hill belt) and the Duars/Bodoland plains that share ethnic ties (Koch-Rajbongshi, Bodo) with the Bhutan border zone. Assam list uses pre-2022 reorganisation units. Bhutan pop 0.79m (WPP-type).
